scope: Local GUI latency fix; no remote commands, router options, candidate algorithms or visual design changed. Local theme computation, form commit signals, path serialization and table population only. OpenWrt operation research exempt for this scope.
changes: Bounded LRU for immutable scaled QSS, keyed by original/prepared text and scale; large text bypasses caching and no widget/manager is retained.
Closing an unchanged settings dialog no longer saves. Existing immediate edit signals still save; unsubmitted form changes flush on close.
Collect dictionary rows directly from already-resolved editor data rather than resolving again twice per collection.
Resolve common portable-path roots once per normalization batch, without a persistent filesystem cache.
Preallocate table row count and suppress intermediate painting while rebuilding; preserve sorting and update state in finally.

visual.note: Resources initialized identically; an earlier cross-process first-frame comparison differed only in the close glyph.

limitations: Offscreen Windows measurements, not an instrumented reproduction of a specific live click.
Warm dialog median improved; first/cold dialog samples did not improve consistently and must not be claimed fixed.
First 300-row build improvement is small; initial widget creation still costs time.
Changed settings still normalize and persist synchronously. Batch root resolution reduces CPU/filesystem work but is not a complete asynchronous persistence redesign.
deployment: Source modified; running application not restarted.
